import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('init.xlsx')

    if c == 'US':
        # highest B for this customer (col A) among non-US countries
        cust = ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value
        best = None

                if best is None or v > best:
                    best = v
        ws.cell(row=r, column=4).value = best

wb.save('output.xlsx')
print("done")
